verdict.rationale: Termius supports converting plain-language descriptions into shell commands via an AI feature in the terminal, which is a clear natural-language command capability, but this is limited to single command generation rather than broader natural-language control of the app (e.g., navigating hosts, managing vaults, or orchestrating workflows via NL). missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI command feature, evidence of natural-language control beyond command generation, and details on accuracy/reliability of the AI feature.
